name: Go FileStore Bot
description: High-performance Telegram File Store Bot written in Go with Multi-Bot Clones support.

OWNER_ID.description: Your Telegram User ID (as primary administrator)

AUTO_DEL.description: Global default time (seconds) to wait before deleting shared messages (0 to disable)

CLONE_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of cloned bots allowed per user ID

CLONE_ALLOW.description: Enable or disable user-cloning features dynamically (true/false)

TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Symmetric passphrase to securely encrypt user bot tokens inside MongoDB

FQDN.description: Your app's domain (e.g. myapp.herokuapp.com) to activate the self-ping anti-sleep worker
